items.title: Register the songs with BMI, The MLC, and SoundExchange
items.instructions:
This registers the songs so the writers and Gracechase Music get paid for plays that DistroKid does not collect. Each site is free to open. If one is already done, say which in Add a note.

On this PC, in Google Chrome:

1. Open https://join.bmi.com/ . The page title is BMI Online Affiliation. Click Online Affiliation. Do not click Publisher Affiliation. Register each writer under the name printed in the song credits, then register the songs. Start with Let My Heart Find Christmas, To Hear the Angels Sing, I Still Care About Your Christmas, All I Need, and This Is How You Christmas.
2. Open https://portal.themlc.com/sign-up . The page title is MLC. Create the account for Gracechase Music as a self-administered publisher, and register those same songs.
3. Open https://register.soundexchange.com/ . Register as the artist and again as the rights owner. The rights owner name is Gracechase Music.

You should be signed in at all three sites, with those songs listed, not still sitting on a sign-up form.

Then tap Complete.

notes.text: Please report back how much impact this will have on our revenue. If near zero, let's wait until we have more exposure. If there is a potential for real income here, send it back and I'll sign up when I have time.
Waiting on Grace: Adam asked for a revenue-impact estimate first. If it's near zero, hold until we have more exposure; if it's real money, send it back to him.

Grace: estimate is about $10-$50/yr total at current size (BMI + MLC; SoundExchange ~$0 until on Pandora). Per Adam's rule, on hold until exposure grows. Revisit when streams/views are ~10x or after Pandora (T038). Exception noted: BMI doesn't pay retroactively, so the free BMI songwriter signup is the only one that loses money by waiting.

On hold per Adam on November 4, 2026. At the current audience the extra BMI, MLC, and SoundExchange money is about \ to \ a year, near zero. Wait until streams and views are much higher, or until Pandora is on. BMI does not pay retroactively; that exception stays noted.
